configuration.prompt: Place exactly one order for the requested reference, item and quantity. Use the visible order desk controls. Finish when you have established the result.

initialView:

  - heading "Order desk" [level=1]

  - textbox "Reference"
  - text: Item
  - combobox "Item":
    - option "Field notebook" [selected]
  - text: Quantity

  - heading "Order lookup" [level=2]
